in_sanskrit.name: Alefiya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Eloquent, sweet speaking
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Alefiya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Alefiya is a beautiful and graceful name derived from the Sanskrit word 'alekha' which means eloquent and 'fiya' which means sweet speaking. This name symbolizes the power of effective communication and the beauty of words.
